title: The Floating Coffin
text: A coffin drifts down the channel toward you, its lid nailed shut, its wood black with water. Something inside is knocking. Not frantic. Politely, three knocks at a time, the way a guest knocks at a door.

outcomes.text: A drowned merchant, very polite, very grateful, who pays you in river pearls.
Something else, much less grateful, and much less polite.

options.label: The wisest knocks back, and asks who is inside.

outcomes.text: It gives a name you know from the House's old debts.
The knocking fades as it drifts away, three knocks, and three, and three.
